title: Superpower header
description: A sticky white bar with a heavy lowercase wordmark at the left and a near-black pill CTA at the right. On desktop the links sit before the CTA and the wordmark starts large, shrinking to three quarters of its size over the first 450px of scroll. On phones: wordmark, CTA and a 3×3-dot menu button that drops the links down under the bar.
notes: sticky: put it at the top level of the page; on phones it overlaps the first section by its own height (72px), on desktop it takes 82px in the flow
the wordmark shrink is a CSS scroll timeline; without support it simply stays at the smaller size
